channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA VISPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
Issued at 02:59 AM 25 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Palawan(Magsaysay and Cuyo) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Iloilo(Guimbal, Tigbauan, Oton, Leganes, Pavia, IloiloCity, Zarraga), #Palawan(Brooke'sPoint, SofronioEspanola, Narra), #OccidentalMindoro(Magsaysay, SanJose) and #Antique(Caluya) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
